annotations.title: Request a time feel check (where does it drag?)

description: Request that real people experience a video, text, flow or waiting screen and report where it drags, when attention drops and how long it felt. Done by the community: several anonymous humans answer through the Human Registry app – fast, remote, directional. Every task is reviewed by a human before it goes out. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot; acting for a business: price on request. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.
